lastCompletedStory.title: Give ship a single documented model source and stop the dead planner/auditor frontmatter rewrite

openQuestions: Carried over from US-002, still unresolved (out of this story's AC scope): vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts's REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS still lists 'model' as required, so a downstream cam init's runVendoredSmoke('check-agent-frontmatter.ts') step will fail against the materialized templates/agents/subagent-*.md copies (which no longer carry a model: line since US-002). Not fixed here either: that file is documented in vendor/README.md as vendored byte-for-byte verbatim from the upstream reporter monorepo. Needs a follow-up: fix upstream in reporter and re-vendor, or make a deliberate, documented local divergence dropping 'model' from REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS.
nextStoryContext: US-003 reduced FRONTMATTER_TARGET_PHASE_PATHS (src/templates/frontmatter.ts) from 3 entries (planner, auditor, ship) down to 1 (ship only). Rationale: US-002's handoff already established that planner and auditor are spawned as pane workers with --model <readPhaseModel(phase)> on the CLI (same mechanism as implementer/reviewer), so rewriting their frontmatter model: line was always dead effort -- doubly so after US-002 stripped that line from the persona files entirely. ship is the sole survivor because ship-runner.ts is deterministic (zero LLM calls, confirmed via its own comment at line 36), so it has no --model CLI path at all; cam-ship.md's frontmatter model: line remains the one live, documented model source for that phase. Updated: the module comment in frontmatter.ts (explains ship-only rationale without literally naming 'planner'/'auditor', since AC1's grep oracle checks the whole file including comments -- see the new patterns.md bullet on this gotcha), config.ts's mergeConfigChoices jsdoc (singular 'file' not 'three... files'), and both test files: test/commands/config-frontmatter.test.ts (removed the planner/auditor path-assertion and rewrite-integration tests, added a 'leaves ... unmodified' integration test, renamed the 'rewrites all three' loop test since it now iterates a 1-entry map) and test/commands/config-persist.test.ts (added one integration test asserting mergeConfigChoices with a cwd rewrites ONLY the seeded cam-ship.md fixture and leaves planner/auditor agent files byte-identical -- this satisfies AC3's oracle, which explicitly names this test file). cam-ship.md's own frontmatter content was deliberately left untouched (dual-copy .claude/+templates/, touching it would trigger embed-vendor:check for no AC-required reason). Quality gates all green: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 4341 pass / 0 fail, check:all full spine (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) clean.
